approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Reuse exact RFI Question and Response scopes already produced by the parser.
Recognize only bounded English direct questions naming one exact RFI.
Require one primary source with the requested explicit role.
Exclude quoted Email history and vision narration.
Fail closed for multiple same-role sources, more than 32 passages or more than 18,000 characters.
Use synthetic evidence and make no provider or mailbox request.
title: Answer exact RFI Question and Response requests locally
objective: Return unambiguous exact RFI Question or Response text from existing local evidence without model cost.
